name: Reptile
author: dreinecke
description: Reptile — desk layouts and quick apps. Pick a desk and see its recording as blocks, drag to swap, drag the line to resize, × removes, + adds; saved as you go, put back on the next visit. The second tab gives an app a key of its own: it opens the app, brings it to the desk you are on, or hides it without closing it, so the next press brings the same page straight back.
